title: Queue and manage batch workloads with Kueue (Red Hat build of Kueue) — clusterqueues, localqueues, and the admission decision

steps.caption: Kueue infrastructure — the kueue.x-k8s.io CRDs are registered

details.label: Page
details.value: Administration > CustomResourceDefinitions, filter kueue

details.label: CRDs
details.value: clusterqueues, localqueues, resourceflavors, workloads + admissionchecks, cohorts (10 total)

details.label: Operator
details.value: Red Hat build of Kueue (RHBoK) 1.3.2, controllers in openshift-operators

steps.caption: The Red Hat build of Kueue operator — CSV Succeeded, Provided APIs: Kueue

details.label: Page
details.value: Ecosystem > Installed Operators > Red Hat build of Kueue

details.label: Status
details.value: Succeeded - Up to date (v1.3.2, stable-v1.3 channel)

details.label: Activation
details.value: The operator waits for the Kueue CR (name: cluster), then rolls out the controllers + CRDs

steps.caption: Create the queue objects — ClusterQueue defines the quota, LocalQueue exposes it to your project

details.label: ClusterQueue
details.value: arcade-demos-cq: BestEffortFIFO, nominalQuota 8 CPU / 32Gi on flavor default-flavor

details.label: LocalQueue
details.value: arcade-demos-lq in this project, points to arcade-demos-cq

details.label: Note
details.value: The cluster already provides the default-flavor ResourceFlavor (auto-provisioned at activation)

steps.caption: LocalQueue arcade-demos-lq — the default-queue annotation marks it as the project default

details.label: Annotation
details.value: kueue.x-k8s.io/default-queue: 'true' — workloads that omit a queue name still get queued

details.label: spec.clusterQueue
details.value: arcade-demos-cq

details.label: Status
details.value: Active / Ready — 'Can submit new workloads to localQueue'

steps.caption: ClusterQueue arcade-demos-cq — the quota pool your workloads draw from

details.label: nominalQuota
details.value: 8 CPU / 32Gi on flavor default-flavor

details.label: queueingStrategy
details.value: BestEffortFIFO

details.label: namespaceSelector
details.value: kubernetes.io/metadata.name: arcade-demos — scopes the queue to this project

steps.caption: Submit a workload — a batch Job bound to the queue with the queue-name label

details.label: Label
details.value: kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: arcade-demos-lq

details.label: Request
details.value: cpu: '1', memory: 512Mi — must fit within the ClusterQueue quota

details.label: Note
details.value: Kueue manages any Job framework in its integrations list; the modules use PyTorchJob via the Training Operator

steps.caption: Kueue admits the workload — the Workload resource records the admission decision

details.label: Workload
details.value: job-kueue-demo-small-63b46 (created by Kueue for the Job)

details.label: admission.clusterQueue
details.value: arcade-demos-cq, podSetAssignments count 1, flavor default-flavor

details.label: Quota
details.value: 1 CPU of the 8-CPU nominalQuota reserved while the pod runs

steps.caption: The admitted job runs — Kueue unsuspended the Job and its pod starts

details.label: Pod
details.value: kueue-demo-small-t8bc5 - Running 1/1

details.label: Mechanics
details.value: Kueue sets spec.suspend until quota is reserved, then unsuspends

details.label: Next
details.value: Now submit a second job that exceeds the quota

steps.caption: Exceed the quota — the same Job with cpu: '50', far above the 8-CPU ClusterQueue quota

details.label: Job
details.value: kueue-demo-xl, same queue-name label

details.label: Request
details.value: cpu: '50', memory: 8Gi

details.label: Expectation
details.value: Kueue creates the Workload but cannot admit it

steps.caption: The admission decision — small job ADMITTED True, oversized job not admitted

details.label: job-kueue-demo-small
details.value: ADMITTED True (arcade-demos-cq)

details.label: job-kueue-demo-xl
details.value: no admission — queued, waiting for quota that never fits

details.label: Mechanics
details.value: 1-2 of 2 workloads queued against the same LocalQueue

steps.caption: Why it is held — the Workload condition explains the insufficient quota

details.label: Condition
details.value: QuotaReserved: False

details.label: Message
details.value: couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient quota for cpu in flavor default-flavor (requests 0 + 50 > maximum capacity 8)

details.label: Pod
details.value: None — the Job stays suspended until the workload is admitted or removed

steps.caption: Queueing in one view — quota decides what runs; conditions explain what waits

details.label: Workloads
details.value: 2 queued against arcade-demos-lq: 1 admitted, 1 held

details.label: Next steps
details.value: Raise the quota, shrink the request, or remove the held workload

details.value: Module 02: watch Kueue make scheduling decisions (BatchJob adaptation)
